description: Two independent offsets: each adds a knob's voltage to an input, or gives that voltage on its own when nothing is patched

params.text: Adds to that half's input, from -5V to 5V
Adds to that half's input, from -5V to 5V

outputs.text: That half's input plus its offset
That half's input plus its offset

notes: with nothing patched into a half, its output carries the knob voltage alone, which makes each half a manual voltage source.
nothing is clamped: a 10V input with the knob at 5V gives 15V out.
